prompts.title: Recent Form — Grouped Count Bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 scene, about 8 seconds flexed to the spoken words, GoatLab charcoal #101412 background. STATISTICAL VARIANT — 'Barras agrupadas de forma': reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles (lime #c5ed74 text on a charcoal band). Top area: Spanish heading 'Forma reciente' in warm white #edf0e6, condensed grotesk, with team column labels 'Ipswich Town FC' (lime #c5ed74) and 'Nottingham Forest FC' (slate #8ca6bf). Chart: grouped count bars on a shared zero baseline across the lower chart zone; three bars per team for 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas' with values {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} for the home side and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} for the visitors; both groups share one common scale whose maximum covers the tallest bar, so heights are directly comparable. Value tags in warm white sit above each bar; the unit caption reads partidos. Under each team label place a sample tag 'muestra · {{home.n}}' and 'muestra · {{away.n}}'; if the two tags differ, flag the smaller one with a slate note 'muestras distintas' so unequal samples are identified. A source line 'Fuente' rendered from the catalog source field sits at the chart foot. Temporal stages: 0–1 s title and team labels slide in; 1–3 s home bars grow from the baseline with staggered ease-out; 3–5 s away bars grow; 5–6 s value tags pop and the tallest bar in each group pulses once in lime for emphasis as the single focal point; 6–8 s hold, then exit. Camera: slow push-in from scale 96 to 100, no lateral drift. Exit transition: bars retract to the baseline and a charcoal wipe carries into the next block; the planner may alternate this statistical block with a creative one. EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Ritmo de resultados': kinetic typography only, no axes, no numbers, no sample claims; the words 'FORMA', 'RITMO', 'PULSO' slam in on beat with the narration, alternating lime and warm white, team names 'Ipswich Town FC' and 'Nottingham Forest FC' striking diagonally; rhythmic scale hits and quick diagonal wipes; exit transition: all words collapse into a single lime stripe that wipes off screen.

prompts.title: Goals For and Against — Paired Bars
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 8 seconds adapted to the narration, charcoal #101412. STATISTICAL VARIANT — 'Goles a favor y en contra': lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Spanish heading 'Goles' top-left in warm white #edf0e6; football context strip behind the chart: a faint top-down half-pitch line drawing in slate #8ca6bf at low opacity, purely decorative. Chart: four paired bars on one shared zero baseline and one common scale in goles — for Ipswich Town FC the pair 'A favor' {{home.gf}} and 'En contra' {{home.ga}}; for Nottingham Forest FC the pair 'A favor' {{away.gf}} and 'En contra' {{away.ga}}. Home pairs in lime #c5ed74, away pairs in slate #8ca6bf, with a small legend 'Ipswich Town FC' / 'Nottingham Forest FC' so no bar is ambiguous; every bar carries a warm white value tag and the unit caption goles anchors the axis. Sample tags 'muestra · {{home.n}}' and 'muestra · {{away.n}}' sit under the team legend, plus a source line 'Fuente' from the catalog source field. Stages: 0–1 s heading and pitch lines fade in; 1–3 s home pair grows from the baseline; 3–5 s away pair grows; 5–6 s the tallest bar pulses once and its tag scales up slightly — the focal point; 6–8 s hold and exit. Camera: gentle tilt down as bars rise. Exit transition: bars sink to the baseline and a lime sweep wipes upward. EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Ruta del balón': illustrative vertical pitch in slate lines; a lime ball leaves the centre circle, traces a glowing curved path with motion trails toward the top goal, the net ripples on impact and a warm white flash marks the shot; team names 'Ipswich Town FC' and 'Nottingham Forest FC' appear as Spanish captions at each end; no numbers, no axes, no sample claims; exit transition: the net ripple expands into a charcoal wipe.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets — Defensive Count
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 7 seconds flexed to the voice track, charcoal #101412. STATISTICAL VARIANT — 'Arcos en cero': lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Spanish heading 'Arcos en cero' in warm white #edf0e6 with a slate subheading 'Defensa'; clean typographic hierarchy, one focal point. Chart: two single count bars on a shared zero baseline and one common scale in partidos — 'Ipswich Town FC' {{home.clean}} in lime #c5ed74 and 'Nottingham Forest FC' {{away.clean}} in slate #8ca6bf; value tags in warm white above each bar. Do not convert counts into rates: no division, no derived ratios, only the raw counts with their unit caption. Under each bar a sample tag 'muestra · {{home.n}}' and 'muestra · {{away.n}}' so each count is read against its sample; a source line 'Fuente' from the catalog source field closes the block. Stages: 0–1 s heading in; 1–2.5 s home bar grows; 2.5–4 s away bar grows; 4–5.5 s tags pop and the larger bar pulses once as the focal point; 5.5–7 s hold and exit. Camera: static frame with a micro push-in. Exit transition: bars retract and a slate diagonal wipe clears the frame. EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Escudo': a stylised shield outline in slate at centre; defensive energy as concentric lime pulses that collapse inward and harden the shield edge; particles strike the shield and slide off with small sparks; the shield tilts, settles with a metallic sheen; Spanish captions 'Defensa' and the team names 'Ipswich Town FC' / 'Nottingham Forest FC' appear sequentially in warm white; no numbers, no axes, no sample claims; exit transition: the shield splits down the middle and both halves slide out as a wipe.

prompts.title: Head-to-Head — Historical Duel
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 8 seconds matched to the narration, charcoal #101412. STATISTICAL VARIANT — 'Cruces previos': lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Spanish heading 'Historial de cruces' in warm white #edf0e6. Chart: three horizontal count bars sharing one zero baseline at the left edge and one common scale in partidos — 'Victorias Ipswich Town FC' {{h2h.homeWins}} in lime #c5ed74, 'Victorias Nottingham Forest FC' {{h2h.awayWins}} in slate #8ca6bf, 'Empates' {{h2h.draws}} in warm white; value tags at each bar end. A total tag 'Cruces previos · {{h2h.total}}' acts as the sample annotation under the heading, with a source line 'Fuente' from the catalog source field at the chart foot. A slate disclaimer chip reads 'Historial, no pronóstico' and stays visible for the whole scene — historical data is not a forecast. Stages: 0–1 s heading, total tag and disclaimer in; 1–3 s bars extend from the baseline in sequence; 3–4.5 s value tags pop; 4.5–6 s the longest bar pulses once in its colour as the single focal point; 6–8 s hold and exit. Camera: slow lateral drift following the growing bars. Exit transition: bars retract leftward and a charcoal wipe closes the block; the planner can alternate it with a creative block. EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Duelo': split-screen duel — a diagonal lime divide splits the frame; 'Ipswich Town FC' enters from the top in lime typography, 'Nottingham Forest FC' from the bottom in slate; the two names push against the divide, the centre line trembles and throws spark particles on each narration beat; a crest-shaped flash marks the clash peak; no numbers, no axes, no sample claims; exit transition: the divide snaps straight and the halves slide apart into the next scene.

prompts.title: Synthesis — Goals Without Reward
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 8 seconds adapted to the spoken words, charcoal #101412. STATISTICAL VARIANT — 'Goles que no se convierten': lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Grounded tension from one compatible recent sample: Ipswich Town FC scores {{home.gf}} goles a favor across its last {{home.n}} partidos yet only {{home.wins}} became 'Victorias' while {{home.losses}} ended in 'Derrotas'. Because goles and partidos are different units, do not draw these on one shared axis: present two stat tiles side by side — tile A 'Goles a favor' with {{home.gf}} and unit caption goles in lime #c5ed74, tile B 'Victorias' with {{home.wins}} and unit caption partidos in slate #8ca6bf — and beneath them a slim strip listing 'Derrotas · {{home.losses}}'. Every tile carries its unit; a sample tag 'muestra · {{home.n}}' and a source line 'Fuente' from the catalog source field anchor the block, and a slate chip notes 'Últimos partidos, sin estimaciones' so history is not read as a forecast; no model estimates appear because none are published. Stages: 0–1 s heading in; 1–3 s tile A counts up; 3–5 s tile B counts up; 5–6 s the strip appears and tile A pulses once as the focal point; 6–8 s hold and exit. Camera: slow push-in toward the tiles. Exit transition: tiles slide apart vertically and a charcoal wipe follows. EDITORIAL VARIANT — 'Reveal y tensión': team reveal — 'IPSWICH TOWN FC' letters assemble from scattered particles in lime; an attacking motif of forward streaks surges upward, then a hard cut to the word 'PERO' in warm white slamming centre-frame; the streaks freeze and fracture; narrative emphasis through scale contrast between surge and freeze; Spanish captions only, no numbers, no axes, no sample claims; exit transition: the fractured streaks fall away as a wipe.
